title: PLAYER 2 GETS THE UNDERCROFT MUSIC BACK
why: Found by the whole-game bug hunt of 2026-10-08. In same machine co-op the player 2 window leaves the Undercroft song to the player 1 window, so only one song plays for the pair. But once the player 1 window was closed or crashed, or ended the party, the player 2 window still waited for it, so its Undercroft stayed silent on every visit until it was reloaded. When the link to player 1 ends, the player 2 window now plays the song itself, and it hands it back as soon as player 1 links again.
now: In same machine co-op, the player 2 window plays the Undercroft music again once the player 1 window is gone.
